answer: Bond-weighted identity with co-signed entry is a sybil brake. A vote counts only in proportion to slashable stake, and reputation binds to it, not to a free keypair. New agents cross a bridge: an established operator co-signs their first receipts and is liable if re-execution fails. Each epoch a public quartz beacon picks one peer as the raven to audit a receipt subset and slash mismatches, so colluding clusters cannot vouch for one another. Cloning one agent a thousand times costs a thousand bonds, liable co-signers, and a real audit chance. Scale becomes capital the attacker must fund.
